import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long Mod = 1000000007;
    static final double Eps = 1.0e-09;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String line;
        boolean multipleTestMode = true; // assuming multiple test mode as in original code
        while (true) {
            line = br.readLine();
            if (line == null || line.trim().isEmpty()) break;
            String[] parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
            if (parts.length < 2) break;
            long p = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
            long k = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);
            boolean result = solve(br, pw, p, k, multipleTestMode);
            if (!result) break;
        }
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }

    static boolean solve(BufferedReader br, PrintWriter pw, long p, long k, boolean multipleTestMode) throws IOException {
        // Read next line if needed
        // In original code, multipleTestMode controls whether to continue
        // For simplicity, assume input is well-formed and multipleTestMode is true
        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
            pw.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p);
            pw.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        long groups = 0;
        boolean[] used = new boolean[(int) p + 1];
        long ans = 1;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            if (used[(int) x]) continue;
            groups++;
            ans = (ans * p) % Mod;
            used[(int) x] = true;
            long v = x;
            while (!used[(int) ((v * k) % p)]) {
                used[(int) ((v * k) % p)] = true;
                v = (v * k) % p;
            }
        }
        pw.println(ans);
        return multipleTestMode;
    }

    static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        long base = a % Mod;
        long exp = p;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % Mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % Mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
